_about: Monochrome Cinema v1 (trained 5 Oct 2026 from 20 refs: snippco r21, symz r14, refinedambition_ x13, snipp.co x3, ciggmedia B&W x2, rehmaneditor999; ~/reels/style-train/monochrome-cinema). Speaker in colour with a moody grade, word-cluster captions (small lead, one huge bold-italic key in a soft accent, small tail), black word cards (wordpage bg black), B&W metaphor cutaways, calm bed. Measured medians: picture change 1.9 s, caption every 0.9 s, 1.5 words per caption change, lowercase, captions ~49% down, face on screen 56%.

director.style: Monochrome Cinema: a cinematic quote edit. The speaker (in colour, moody) carries it; the reel keeps cutting between the speaker, black word cards and black-and-white METAPHOR cutaways. Typography is the hero.
director.captions: captions.heroes: one hero per phrase (the word that carries the line). captions.serif: 1-2 emotional words in the serif. Lowercase.
director.wordcards: 2-3 wordpage scenes per 20 s with bg black on short punch lines (2-4 words, e.g. 'why not you'): one spoken word at a time; big: the payoff word; serif: the emotional word. 0.4-1.2 s.
director.cutaways: 3-4 image scenes per 20 s, grade grayscale(1) contrast(1.22) brightness(0.96), captions: true, 0.8-1.8 s, METAPHORS from stock_fetch.py (public domain / CC0): mind->brain/MRI, discipline->statue, scale->galaxy/city, the masses->crowd, time->clock, learning->old library.
director.rhythm: Picture changes every ~1.9 s (cuts, punches, cards, cutaways). Never two cutaways back to back without returning to the speaker or a word card. Leave 0.5-1 s on the speaker after the payoff.
